svg.title: How SFP works
svg.desc: You keep talking to your AI as usual. SFP hands it the right instructions first. You ask, SFP reads your words and project, picks a few skills, your AI follows them, you say if they helped, and it learns.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
